reader.requirement: At --std 85, after a successful OPEN of an indexed file, each X cell of Table 2 (by access mode and open mode) must execute and each blank cell must not: the compiler refuses EXTEND on random/dynamic access (SR1) and START on random access, and the runtime refuses the rest with IX.1.3.4's 47/48/49; a statement after an unsuccessful OPEN is refused too. The witness covers the X cells only.

file sharing facility off at 85 (no Table 19 arbitration, no '61'); not an outcome of this rule in one run unit

reader.edition-search: grep 'Edition|DialectBehavior|Year|DialectLevel' over the guards, IndexedConnector.Write, StatementValidation.CheckOpenModeForFile (its EXTEND/access arm has no edition test; only the FORMAT-clause arm reads DialectLevel, not reached here) and KeyedIoBinder.BindStart's random-access test (no edition)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the Table 2 outcome is identical at 85 and 2023 (p2table2-002 at 2023 printed the same lines)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf24_09 runs every X cell; the blank cells (refusal half) are not exercised (probed here)

probes.expected: Table 2 X cells succeed; blank cells are not permissible and are refused with the IX.1.3.4 4x value (the Seq I-O WRITE cell has no value 1985 assigns, so the 48 is the implementor's choice)

probes.printed: COBOL2372 OPEN EXTEND 'XR' (RANDOM) and 'XV' (DYNAMIC) refused; COBOL0862 START on random-access 'XR' refused
probes.expected: §1985:IX.4.4.3 SR1: EXTEND only for sequential access (Table 2's Random/Dynamic Extend column); Table 2's blank Random START row

reader.notes: Every Table 2 cell was probed. The sequential-access I-O WRITE cell is blank but 1985's 48 text names 'not open in the I-O, output, or extend mode', so no listed value applies; the runtime answers 48 and writes nothing, within the implementor's choice for a 4x critical condition.

refuter.evidence: Re-read Table 2 (IX-25): reader's cell list matches. The sequential-access I-O WRITE cell is blank in Table 2 while IX.4.9.4 GR1 admits I-O mode and IX.1.3.4's 48 names only 'not open in the I-O, output, or extend mode', so 1985 assigns no status to that cell; the runtime writes nothing and answers 48. GR4 itself only says which statements may be used and prescribes no runtime result for a blank cell, so the 48 is outside this rule (noted, not a ground to overturn). START on random access is refused at compile time, consistent with IX.4.7.3 SR1. q2misc-001: CLOSE WITH LOCK, OPEN 38, then READ 47 (no permissible statement runs without a successful OPEN). Later-edition OPEN/READ phrases refused at 85 (q3l1..q3l5). cite: OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR4 [may be used with the open mode given at the top of the column]; OK §1985:IX.4.9.4 GR1 [must be open in the output, I-O, or extend mode].
